Town of Superior Board of Trustees Streaming Media Archive

Archived videos are arranged by date, with the most recent at the top of the list. Click Video to watch the meeting with documents, or Agenda / Minutes to see just the documents. You can also search the archives by typing keywords into the Search box.

To enable the most effective streaming experience for all browsers and operating systems, please download and install Silverlight from Microsoft.

In order to watch videos on our site, make sure you have the following system requirements:

  • Windows PC's require installing Silverlight to stream both Live and Archived content
  • Mac PC's require installing Silverlight to stream both Live and Archived content
  • iOS devices (iPad, iPhone) devices can watch both Live and Archived content
  • Select Android and Windows devices can watch both Live and Archived content

The minimum system requirements for watching Town of Superior video content are available here.
